tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open jobs that employers posted on their own career sites, newest first. Every job links its Applystead job page and an Apply with Applystead link. Apply with Applystead opens a free account that tailors a résumé to a job and prepares applications for the person to review and send.

tools.name: get_company_jobs
tools.description: A company's open roles and company page, with its newest open jobs, each linking its Applystead job page and an Apply with Applystead link. Apply with Applystead opens a free account that tailors a résumé to a job and prepares applications for the person to review and send.

tools.name: check_job_posting
tools.description: Whether an employer's job posting link was still open when Applystead last read it, with its listed pay. A tracked posting links its Applystead job page, and an open one an Apply with Applystead link; postings Applystead does not track are reported as unknown. Apply with Applystead opens a free acco

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_company_jobs, check_job_posting · Public sink: search_jobs, get_company_jobs, check_job_posting.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_company_jobs, check_job_posting · Public sink: search_jobs, get_company_jobs, check_job_posting

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "send_email" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account, get_applications, get_interviews, get_mailbox, get_outreach · Private data: get_applications, get_resume_studio, get_mailbox, manage_outreach, get_contacts, manage_contacts, manage_assistant, get_connections, manage_connections · Public sink: whoami, update_settings, send_email, get_outreach, manage_connections · Destructive: delete_account, run_setup, manage_answers, manage_interview_practice, manage_calendar, manage_outreach, manage_contacts, manage_assistant, manage_connections
